result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Vendor provides third-party indemnity for IP claims, legal violations, Vendor-caused data breaches, and gross negligence or wilful misconduct; Customer and its Affiliates are protected; and notice, defence control, and cooperation procedures are included. Customer’s indemnity is appropriately narrowed to Customer-provided content and Customer’s breach of law. The changes are targeted and preserve unrelated terms. Drafting is strong, though the retained reference in Section 9.3 to remedies under Section 20.5 appears unresolved because no Section 20.5 is included in the rendered clause.
